code_examples.section: ltm rule command XLAT src addr
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

XLAT::src_addr
       Retrieve the source translation address.

SYNOPSIS
       XLAT::src_addr

DESCRIPTION
       Retrieve the source translation address.

RETURN VALUE
       Return the string representation of the source translation address.

VALID DURING
       SA_PICKED

EXAMPLES
	when SA_PICKED {
	    log local0. "[XLAT::src_addr]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-14.1.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
